name: form-field
title: Form Field
description: A layout wrapper that provides consistent spacing between label, input, and hint elements.

docs.lead: A thin layout wrapper for form fields. Provides consistent gap spacing between label, input, and hint components.
docs.usage:
import * as FormField from "@/components/ui/form-field"
import * as Label from "@/components/ui/label"
import * as Hint from "@/components/ui/hint"

<FormField.Root>
  <Label.Root>Email<Label.Asterisk /></Label.Root>
  <Input.Root>...</Input.Root>
  <Hint.Root>This is a hint.</Hint.Root>
</FormField.Root>

examples.title: Demo
examples.description: Form field with label, input, and hint.
examples.code:
<FormField.Root>
  <Label.Root>
    Email Address
    <Label.Asterisk />
    <Label.Info>We'll use this to contact you.</Label.Info>
  </Label.Root>
  <Input.Root>
    <Input.Wrapper>
      <Input.Icon as={RiMailLine} />
      <Input.Input placeholder="hello@example.com" />
    </Input.Wrapper>
  </Input.Root>
  <Hint.Root>
    <Hint.Icon as={RiInformationFill} />
    This is a hint text to help user.
  </Hint.Root>
</FormField.Root>

api.name: FormField.Root
api.description: Layout wrapper with flex-col gap-1 spacing. Accepts all div props.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional className to override or extend styling
